architectureSignals: 架构机制：meta-skill 根据领域目标设计 Agent 团队、生成专用技能、定义交接和验证边界；阅读时把 HTML 代码入口、数据/配置形态、自动化脚本和边界条件连起来看，而不是只看 README 的安装示例。
适用团队：HTML 团队中已有明确痛点、且能安排小样本验证的工程组。
落地路径：围绕 Harness — The Team Architecture Factory for Claude Code 做最小 spike，把接入面限定在非核心路径。
生产风险：自动生成 Agent 团队会放大错误角色假设，必须人工审查权限、目标和验证标准。
决策问题：它解决的是「复杂任务需要临时组织多个专业 Agent，但手工写角色、技能和交接规则成本高」的主矛盾，还是只会给现有流程增加新的维护面？

valueHypothesis: 如果团队确实存在「复杂任务需要临时组织多个专业 Agent，但手工写角色、技能和交接规则成本高」，revfactory/harness 的收益应体现为 生成技能可用率、交接缺陷、任务完成率、人工修改量、越权风险 的改善。
适合先复制机制、接口或治理方式，不适合未验证成本就全量迁移。

items.title: SilverTorch: Index as Model — A New Retrieval Paradigm for Recommendation Systems
items.summary: Meta 最新 ML Applications 文章把推荐召回索引做成 index-as-model：用模型化索引统一候选生成、表征和 GPU serving，报告高吞吐和成本效率收益；它代表推荐系统从“ANN 索引 + ranker”向可学习检索层演进。

interpretation.businessProblem: UGC/Feed 推荐的候选池巨大且更新快，传统向量索引和后续 ranker 割裂，容易出现召回质量、吞吐和 GPU 成本三者互相拉扯。
interpretation.systemMechanism: 把索引本身建模，让候选生成、用户/内容表征、检索得分和 serving 策略在同一套模型化框架中优化，并用 GPU serving 承接高吞吐。
interpretation.metricsAndExperiment: 重点看 recall@K、覆盖率、新内容发现、P95/P99 延迟、QPS/GPU、单位候选成本、线上 CTR/时长和负反馈；必须对比旧 ANN/规则召回漏斗。
interpretation.borrowable: 可借鉴“召回层也要像模型一样治理”：离线/在线一致性、版本回滚、索引刷新和成本监控进入同一张实验看板。
interpretation.boundary: 物料规模不大、召回瓶颈不明显、没有 GPU serving 能力或缺少召回/排序联合 owner 时，不适合照搬。

items.title: Unlocking dependable responses with Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform's Agentic RAG
items.summary: Google Research/Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform 将企业 RAG 做成 agentic retrieval 工作流，用 sufficient-context agent 判断证据是否足够，再循环补检索；核心价值是把“回答前是否有足够证据”系统化。

interpretation.businessProblem: 企业搜索/RAG 经常在权限、跨语料、多跳问题和证据不足时给出自信答案，传统一次性检索很难判断“还能不能回答”。
interpretation.systemMechanism: 引入检索 Agent、上下文充足性判断、证据补齐和答案生成分工，让系统在回答前循环检查上下文是否覆盖问题。
interpretation.metricsAndExperiment: 观察 answer faithfulness、引用覆盖率、无答案拒答率、二次检索次数、权限误召、P95 延迟和人工验收通过率。
interpretation.borrowable: 适合企业知识库、客服搜索和内部政策问答：先把“证据不足”做成可观测状态，再优化检索和生成。
interpretation.boundary: 如果权限模型混乱、文档源不可追溯或 latency budget 很紧，agentic RAG 会先放大成本和链路复杂度。

interpretation.businessProblem: 广告排序想用更大模型捕捉复杂意图和商业价值，但实时竞价链路要求毫秒级延迟、稳定预算和可解释的广告主价值。
interpretation.systemMechanism: 用 adaptive ranking 在候选级决定投入多少模型计算，把轻量筛选、重模型精排、预算约束和服务容量共同优化。
interpretation.metricsAndExperiment: 同时看 CTR、CVR、ROAS/CPA、广告质量、用户负反馈、P95/P99 延迟、GPU 成本和预算消耗曲线。
interpretation.borrowable: 把“模型大小”改成“算力分配策略”：高价值/不确定候选走重模型，低价值候选保留轻路径。

items.title: Using LLMs to amplify human labeling and improve Dash search relevance
items.summary: Dropbox Dash 用少量人工标注加 LLM 辅助标注训练搜索排序模型，目标不是“用 LLM 替代搜索”，而是用 LLM 扩大长尾 query-document 相关性标签覆盖。

interpretation.businessProblem: 企业搜索长尾查询多、权限和上下文复杂，纯人工标注覆盖不足，排序模型缺少稳定训练和评测信号。

items.title: How we optimized Dash's relevance judge with DSPy
items.summary: Dropbox 用 DSPy 把 Dash relevance judge 的提示词迁移和优化变成可测流程：定义任务、数据和 NMSE 指标，再用优化器适配更低成本的开源模型。

interpretation.businessProblem: LLM judge 可以扩展搜索相关性评估，但手写 prompt 脆弱、跨模型迁移差，昂贵模型无法支撑海量 query-document 打分。

interpretation.boundary: 评测集太小、标签标准不清或业务语义快速变化时，DSPy 优化可能只是在过拟合现有样本。

items.title: Novelty-Aware Agentic Retrieval: Comparing Research Contributions Through Structured Multi-Step Reasoning
items.summary: Scientific literature search is an information retrieval (IR) task in which ranked lists are insufficient: a researcher entering a new area needs to know not only which papers are relevant, but how they relate, where they overlap, how they differ, and what problem-method combinations are absent. Standard retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) summarizes documents independently, discarding this comparative signal. We present the Novelty-Aware Research Agent, a prototype agentic retrieval system that layers structured multi-step reasoning on a RAG pipeline through six typed-contract components: query analysis, a ReAct-style retrieval loop, relevance ranking, schema-guided contribution extraction, a three-pass comparison agent, and answer generation. Beyond returning relevant papers, it produces structured comparison artifacts: per-paper contribution records, paper-level overlaps, and a problem x method gap matrix. On a 100-paper corpus, the system supports five structured comparison capabilities that a standard RAG baseline supports none of, while remaining query-sensitive: across three main queries no paper appears in all three top-5 sets (mean pairwise Jaccard 0.12), and an extended seven-query evaluation holds the pattern across ten queries (mean Jaccard 0.115, 18 of 29 retrieved papers query-exclusive). Under author-assigned graded relevance the ranker attains mean Precision@5 1.000 and nDCG@5 0.752 on the main queries, ahead of BM25, dense, and hybrid retrieval; over ten queries Precision@5 is non-saturated at 0.980 with nDCG@5 0.739. Schema compliance is 86.7% on the main queries and 84.0% over the ten-query set, and validating 20 sampled empty gap-matrix cells yields a gap precision of 0.600. We discuss the latency-structure trade-off in agentic retrieval and identify corpus scale, author-assigned labels, and limited independent evaluation as the main limitations.

items.title: SproutRAG: Attention-Guided Tree Search with Progressive Embeddings for Long-Document RAG
items.summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems must balance retrieval granularity with contextual coherence, a challenge that existing methods address through LLM-guided chunking, single-level context expansion, or hierarchical summarization. These approaches variously depend on costly LLM calls during indexing or retrieval, limit context aggregation to a single granularity level, or introduce information loss through summarization. We present SproutRAG, an attention-guided hierarchical RAG framework that addresses this trade-off by organizing sentence-level chunks into progressively larger but semantically coherent units, using learned inter-sentence attention to construct a binary chunking tree. Unlike prior approaches that rely on external LLMs, fixed context expansion, or lossy summarization, SproutRAG learns which attention heads and layers best capture semantic document structure, enabling multi-granularity retrieval without additional LLM calls or compressed summaries. At retrieval time, SproutRAG uses hierarchical beam search to retrieve candidates at multiple granularities, capturing multi-sentence relevance beyond flat retrieval. The framework is trained end-to-end with a joint objective that improves both embeddings and tree structure. Experiments across four benchmarks spanning scientific, legal, and open-domain settings demonstrate that SproutRAG improves information efficiency (IE) by 6.1% on average over the strongest baseline. Code is available on https://github.com/AmirAbaskohi/SproutRAG.

items.title: Scaling Managed Agents: Decoupling the brain from the hands

interpretation.signal: 长周期 Agent 的核心问题是状态、凭据和执行边界，不是多开几个子 Agent。
interpretation.impact: 企业如果要让 Agent 处理跨系统任务，需要先把 OAuth token、仓库权限、工具调用和恢复状态从模型上下文里移出去。
interpretation.action: 构建 managed-agent 原型时优先验证凭据不可达、MCP 代理审计、任务恢复和异常中止，而不是先追求工具数量。

items.impact: Agent 平台会从 prompt orchestration 走向运行时治理。
items.action: 按“模型上下文、执行环境、凭据库、工具代理、任务状态”拆分内部 Agent 架构。

items.title: How we built Claude Code auto mode: a safer way to skip permissions
items.summary: Claude Code auto mode 试图在 sandboxing 和完全跳过权限之间找中间态：用风险分类、约束执行和可解释提示降低审批疲劳，同时保留高风险操作的控制权。

interpretation.signal: Agent 自主性正在从二元开关变成基于风险分层的权限系统。
interpretation.impact: 研发团队需要定义哪些操作可自动执行、哪些要确认、哪些永远禁止；否则 auto 模式会把效率收益转成不可审计风险。
interpretation.action: 把命令、网络、写文件、包安装、凭据读取分成 allow/ask/deny 三档，并用真实 PR 回放校验误放行率。

items.impact: 权限体验会影响开发者是否愿意让 Agent 长时间独立工作。
items.action: 先在低风险仓库试点 auto/ask 策略，再扩大到核心代码库。

items.title: SilverTorch: Index as Model — A New Retrieval Paradigm for Recommendation Systems
items.summary: Meta 最新 ML Applications 文章把推荐召回索引做成 index-as-model：用模型化索引统一候选生成、表征和 GPU serving，报告高吞吐和成本效率收益；它代表推荐系统从“ANN 索引 + ranker”向可学习检索层演进。

interpretation.businessProblem: UGC/Feed 推荐的候选池巨大且更新快，传统向量索引和后续 ranker 割裂，容易出现召回质量、吞吐和 GPU 成本三者互相拉扯。
interpretation.systemMechanism: 把索引本身建模，让候选生成、用户/内容表征、检索得分和 serving 策略在同一套模型化框架中优化，并用 GPU serving 承接高吞吐。
interpretation.metricsAndExperiment: 重点看 recall@K、覆盖率、新内容发现、P95/P99 延迟、QPS/GPU、单位候选成本、线上 CTR/时长和负反馈；必须对比旧 ANN/规则召回漏斗。
interpretation.borrowable: 可借鉴“召回层也要像模型一样治理”：离线/在线一致性、版本回滚、索引刷新和成本监控进入同一张实验看板。
interpretation.boundary: 物料规模不大、召回瓶颈不明显、没有 GPU serving 能力或缺少召回/排序联合 owner 时，不适合照搬。

items.title: Unlocking dependable responses with Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform's Agentic RAG
items.summary: Google Research/Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform 将企业 RAG 做成 agentic retrieval 工作流，用 sufficient-context agent 判断证据是否足够，再循环补检索；核心价值是把“回答前是否有足够证据”系统化。

interpretation.businessProblem: 企业搜索/RAG 经常在权限、跨语料、多跳问题和证据不足时给出自信答案，传统一次性检索很难判断“还能不能回答”。
interpretation.systemMechanism: 引入检索 Agent、上下文充足性判断、证据补齐和答案生成分工，让系统在回答前循环检查上下文是否覆盖问题。
interpretation.metricsAndExperiment: 观察 answer faithfulness、引用覆盖率、无答案拒答率、二次检索次数、权限误召、P95 延迟和人工验收通过率。
interpretation.borrowable: 适合企业知识库、客服搜索和内部政策问答：先把“证据不足”做成可观测状态，再优化检索和生成。
interpretation.boundary: 如果权限模型混乱、文档源不可追溯或 latency budget 很紧，agentic RAG 会先放大成本和链路复杂度。

items.title: Meta Adaptive Ranking Model: Bending the Inference Scaling Curve to Serve LLM-Scale Models for Ads
items.summary: Meta Adaptive Ranking Model 关注广告排序中 LLM-scale 模型的服务成本：不是简单加大模型，而是按候选价值、延迟预算和推理曲线自适应分配模型容量。

interpretation.businessProblem: 广告排序想用更大模型捕捉复杂意图和商业价值，但实时竞价链路要求毫秒级延迟、稳定预算和可解释的广告主价值。
interpretation.systemMechanism: 用 adaptive ranking 在候选级决定投入多少模型计算，把轻量筛选、重模型精排、预算约束和服务容量共同优化。
interpretation.metricsAndExperiment: 同时看 CTR、CVR、ROAS/CPA、广告质量、用户负反馈、P95/P99 延迟、GPU 成本和预算消耗曲线。
interpretation.borrowable: 把“模型大小”改成“算力分配策略”：高价值/不确定候选走重模型，低价值候选保留轻路径。
interpretation.boundary: 转化回传慢、预算归因弱、实验平台不成熟或流量规模小的团队，很难验证自适应推理收益。

interpretation.businessProblem: 购物广告只按点击优化会偏向短期兴趣，不能充分表达广告主真正关心的购买/转化价值，且 offsite conversion 回传稀疏又延迟。

interpretation.borrowable: 电商/本地生活广告可借鉴：候选生成阶段就引入最终业务目标，不要把转化压力全部留给精排。

items.title: Enhancing Ad Relevance: Integrating Real-Time Context into Sequential Recommender Models

interpretation.metricsAndExperiment: 观察实时特征 freshness、CVR/ROAS、CTR、负反馈、特征缺失率、在线 serving 延迟和实时管道故障时的降级效果。
interpretation.borrowable: 适合高频行为场景：把实时上下文作为候选生成输入，而不是只在精排末端补一个特征。
interpretation.boundary: 实时特征质量差、事件延迟高、用户行为稀疏或缺少实时特征监控时，模型可能学到噪声。

items.title: Novelty-Aware Agentic Retrieval: Comparing Research Contributions Through Structured Multi-Step Reasoning
items.summary: Scientific literature search is an information retrieval (IR) task in which ranked lists are insufficient: a researcher entering a new area needs to know not only which papers are relevant, but how they relate, where they overlap, how they differ, and what problem-method combinations are absent. Standard retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) summarizes documents independently, discarding this comparative signal. We present the Novelty-Aware Research Agent, a prototype agentic retrieval system that layers structured multi-step reasoning on a RAG pipeline through six typed-contract components: query analysis, a ReAct-style retrieval loop, relevance ranking, schema-guided contribution extraction, a three-pass comparison agent, and answer generation. Beyond returning relevant papers, it produces structured comparison artifacts: per-paper contribution records, paper-level overlaps, and a problem x method gap matrix. On a 100-paper corpus, the system supports five structured comparison capabilities that a standard RAG baseline supports none of, while remaining query-sensitive: across three main queries no paper appears in all three top-5 sets (mean pairwise Jaccard 0.12), and an extended seven-query evaluation holds the pattern across ten queries (mean Jaccard 0.115, 18 of 29 retrieved papers query-exclusive). Under author-assigned graded relevance the ranker attains mean Precision@5 1.000 and nDCG@5 0.752 on the main queries, ahead of BM25, dense, and hybrid retrieval; over ten queries Precision@5 is non-saturated at 0.980 with nDCG@5 0.739. Schema compliance is 86.7% on the main queries and 84.0% over the ten-query set, and validating 20 sampled empty gap-matrix cells yields a gap precision of 0.600. We discuss the latency-structure trade-off in agentic retrieval and identify corpus scale, author-assigned labels, and limited independent evaluation as the main limitations.

items.title: SproutRAG: Attention-Guided Tree Search with Progressive Embeddings for Long-Document RAG
items.summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems must balance retrieval granularity with contextual coherence, a challenge that existing methods address through LLM-guided chunking, single-level context expansion, or hierarchical summarization. These approaches variously depend on costly LLM calls during indexing or retrieval, limit context aggregation to a single granularity level, or introduce information loss through summarization. We present SproutRAG, an attention-guided hierarchical RAG framework that addresses this trade-off by organizing sentence-level chunks into progressively larger but semantically coherent units, using learned inter-sentence attention to construct a binary chunking tree. Unlike prior approaches that rely on external LLMs, fixed context expansion, or lossy summarization, SproutRAG learns which attention heads and layers best capture semantic document structure, enabling multi-granularity retrieval without additional LLM calls or compressed summaries. At retrieval time, SproutRAG uses hierarchical beam search to retrieve candidates at multiple granularities, capturing multi-sentence relevance beyond flat retrieval. The framework is trained end-to-end with a joint objective that improves both embeddings and tree structure. Experiments across four benchmarks spanning scientific, legal, and open-domain settings demonstrate that SproutRAG improves information efficiency (IE) by 6.1% on average over the strongest baseline. Code is available on https://github.com/AmirAbaskohi/SproutRAG.
